source_refs.note: 2. Peripatric Speciation: a main subheading of 1.8 Species and speciation, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 33-33.

blocks.text: It involves a small, isolated population at the edge of a larger population. The small population undergoes rapid evolutionary changes, leading to divergence from the original population. An example can be seen in island species that evolve from a small founding population.
